idlePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE polished full-body BACK-VIEW character sprite on a truly transparent background for a 2D runner game.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative character DESIGN, CLOTHING, PALETTE and FLAT ILLUSTRATION STYLE reference (front view). Image 2 is the rear-view pose reference to CORRECT, its striped blue clothing, green cuffs and rough texture are wrong. Image 3 is only context for a rear-facing character going away from the viewer, never reproduce its background.
Primary request: redraw the same woman standing still and facing directly away from the viewer, sharp and clean, wearing the outfit of Image 1 faithfully. Entire head, hands, legs and both shoes visible, no cropping. Neutral rear-view standing pose, feet slightly apart, arms relaxed beside the torso. A readable model-sheet base for subsequent running animation.
Identity: slender stylized woman, a proportionally large rounded head, extremely long straight dark blue-black hair hanging as a broad simple smooth curtain down to her waist/upper hips with a nearly blunt lower edge, matching the front reference's silhouette and length. Narrow torso, long legs. Pale cool pink hands. The small elongated orange earrings from the front may be just barely visible beside her head, partially hidden by hair. No face or eyes in this rear view.
Clothing: plain muted lavender blazer and matching loose flared trousers exactly like Image 1. Smooth normal shoulder seams, straight sleeves, plain cuffs, blazer lower hem at hip level with a small natural central rear vent; hair covers most of its back. No pinstripes, no blue denim, no green trims, no invented patterns. The yellow collared shirt and orange patterned tie belong to the front and should stay hidden from this strictly rear-facing view. Black pointed closed shoes with modest chunky heels matching Image 1, tiny pale ankle slivers at trouser hems. Do not change into sneakers, boots or stilettos.
Style/medium: clean 2D flat hand-drawn illustration with simple muted opaque color blocks, thin dark indigo outlines and only a few precise minimal fold strokes. Match the front reference's graphic shapes rather than realistic anatomy. Pale lavender suit approximately #a3a0c8, restrained darker lavender fold plane #8785af, hair deep petrol blue-black #102b39, pale rose skin #edcbd8. No rendered hair strands, no noisy grain, no fabric texture, no muddy watercolor, no glossy gradients, no excessive shadows, no oversaturated colors, no 3D.
Composition: single centered character only, orthographic straight rear view, neutral eye-level camera. Portrait 1024x1536 composition, figure about 75% of canvas height with clear transparent padding above head, below shoes and at sides. Fixed proportions suitable for a sprite sequence.
Background: actual transparent RGBA alpha, including gaps between hands, torso and legs. No floor, shadow, chessboard, landscape, frame, platform, text, labels, watermark, props, dust, glow or extra objects.
